name: Brockwell Park Playground
description: Large children's playground and wet play area in Brockwell Park, run by Lambeth Council. The wet play area usually opens from the last Saturday in May to the last weekend in September, but can close on some days for repairs. The park is open from 7.30am to 15 minutes before sunset.
